title: Holiday Ad Photos and Videos for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Make holiday ad photos and videos from one product photo. Type dates, prices, or offers in the editor, then reuse the scene when those details change.
h1: Create Holiday Ad Photos and Videos Fast
lead: Paste a product link and get holiday photos and videos: a script, an actor, and a spoken voice. Then type the shipping date yourself.

faq.q: How many credits does a holiday photo or video use?
faq.a: Credits are what each photo or video uses. A photo uses 24 credits. A video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the cost before you start. If it fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Can I add a spoken voice, music, and captions to the holiday clip?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, a track from the music library, and captions (the words on screen) in the editor. Use a track you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday scenes for a whole catalog at once?
faq.a: Yes. You can run many product links at once, and each one comes back as its own gift scene. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can the gift message use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one, describe a festive look, or build one from a short clip of you. People in the scene are generated. They are not real customers, real celebrities, or people you hired.

faq.q: What happens to the ad after the holiday ends?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the spoken voice, or the offer in the editor, and use the scene again for the next holiday.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page. The photos and the details come in, ready for the ad. You can also upload the clear photo you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta from here?
faq.a: Yes. Publish in one click to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta, or download the file. Meta here means Facebook and Instagram. It stays in your account until you share it, and the download has no AIVideosUGC watermark.

faq.q: Can my own tools request holiday ads?
faq.a: Yes. An API is a connection that lets your own tools ask for a holiday ad from a product link. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.

faq.q: What shape should the holiday video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. A clip can run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Pick a shape: tall 9:16 for a phone, square 1:1, wide 16:9, or 4:3 and 3:4. Each video is a separate run.

faq.q: How do I put an order-by date on the ad?
faq.a: Type the order-by date in the editor. As that date gets closer, you can change it and keep the same gift scene.

faq.q: Can the same script be spoken in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Pick another language for the spoken voice, so shoppers somewhere else hear the gift message in their language.

faq.q: Can I make Mother's Day product ads the same way?
faq.a: Yes. Describe a Mother's Day table or gift scene instead of a winter one, and add that occasion's date after you confirm it.

reviews.h2: How shops build gift guide product images
reviews.lead: Three ways a shop gets the gift scene up before the cutoff is confirmed.

items.t: Have an actor lift the set
items.d: They paste the gift-set page and ask an actor to lift it from the box. The order-by date is typed later, so a new date can keep the same scene.

items.t: Stand a generated actor by the coat
items.d: They keep the coat's color and shape, with an actor next to an open gift. That actor is generated, not a hired customer.

items.t: Keep the candle, change the voice
items.d: They download the candle-and-ribbon scene once. Next weekend they only change the language of the voice and the offer line.
